Players Committee card image of [[Lieutenant Venka (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploys -1 to Executor. While aboard a capital starship, adds 1 to armor and its defense value may not be reduced. While Fear Will Keep Them In Line here, when you win a battle at a related site where you have an Imperial, opponent loses 2 Force.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/lieutenantvenka.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
